$doc: Config des teams. Chaque team = 1 workspace programa nommé `title`, 1 lead Claude (Fable 5) + des workers.
WORKERS — catalogue dans defaults.workers, clé = nom du fichier agents/<nom>.md.
Entrée = { model, description?, vars?, file? }  ou  "<model>" (raccourci)  ou  false (retire ce worker pour la team).
Par team: `workers` fusionne avec defaults.workers (ajout / surcharge / retrait). `workers_replace: true` ignore les defaults.
vars: injectées dans le prompt de l'agent via {{nom}}. Built-ins: {{team}}, {{cwd}}, {{shared_dir}}.
Chemins relatifs à ce fichier. Ajouter une team = 1 entrée ici + prompts/<name>.md.
`enabled: false` sur une team = ignorée par le lanceur (garde l'exemple sans le lancer).
RUNNERS — quel binaire lance le lead: defaults.runner ou team.runner, clé de `runners` = { command, brain?, drop_flags?, healthcheck?, start? }.
shell_prompt_regex — motif du prompt zsh attendu avant de taper la commande dans un nouveau workspace.
prices_per_mtok — optionnel: { "<model>": {"in","out","cache_read","cache_write"} } en $/M tokens pour que `teams cost` affiche des dollars.

gc — housekeeping loop started by `teams up`, zero LLM tokens: interval_sec (300), worker_idle_min (10: a worker silent that long → one line typed to its lead, who TaskStops it), nudge_every_min (30), orphan_age_min (10: dead sessions' ~/.claude/teams|tasks dirs older than this are removed).
learn: false — team sans repo (ex: design, cwd = shared/design): ignorée par `teams learn`.

disallowed_tools — defaults.disallowed_tools + team.disallowed_tools → --disallowedTools (lead + workers; wildcards ok, tools removed from context). `disallowed_tools_replace: true` ignores the defaults for that team.
Figma arrives in EVERY session via the claude.ai connector (mcp__claude_ai_Figma__*): denied by default, allowed only for design. Same trick works for any connector a team doesn't need.

plugins — plugins disabled at user scope but enabled for this team only (--settings enabledPlugins). Note: plugin MCP servers may not load this way; the figma plugin is NOT needed by design (connector + tools/figma/ replace its skills).
agents/<w>.md frontmatter `tools: A, B` — restricts that worker's tools. CAUTION: any list removes ToolSearch, so deferred MCP tools become unreachable; leave it out for workers that use MCP.
